title: New Roof Penetration
description: I was called out this house because the dryer was not working correctly. Upon inspection a majority if the duct work was incorrect, I wan able to correct the issues and get the dryer working correctly. This job required that a new roof penetration was needed to get the dryer to exhaust correctly. In addition, the previous installer had used a rectangle duct which was buried in the wall. I was able to install a transition in the attic from rectangle to round and create a new roof penetration, the dryer is now working as it should.

title: First Cleaning in 27 Years!
description: I was called out to this customer’s house for a standard residential dryer vent cleaning upon speaking to the homeowner. It turns out the vent has never been cleaned, which is 27 years. It was unbelievable. The amount of lint in this vent two air whips a rod run from both sides. A new transition duct installed behind the dryer and the dryer is now in good safe operational shape.

title: Booster Fan Repair & Vent Cleaning
description: Customer called me our for a standard dryer vent cleaning. It turns out they had a booster fan removed and the removal was not correctly. I was able to correctly repair the previous job. This job called for hard pipe and not flexible material. Once I made the duct repair I performed a full vent cleaning and got the dryer back in a good safe working order

title: Residential Dryer Vent Cleaning
description: This was a dryer vent that had not been serviced in many years. When I arrive the I found that the pest control company had installed a screen over the termination. This was completely blocking the airflow. I removed the screen and fully serviced the vent. The customer is now in good shape.

title: Dryer Exhaust Re-route
description: I was called out by this customer over concerns of the length of the dryer exhaust system upon inspection. I came up with a solution to dramatically reduce the length of the run. I used long sweep elbows from innovate once I removed the excess length of reassembled the duct system and the dryer is not working as it should.
